name: 黑頸鸊鷉
illustrationTaxon: Podiceps nigricollis adult non-breeding (winter) plumage; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 鳳頭鸊鷉大得多（46–61 cm）、身體與頸較長，喙長而纖細；冬羽有清晰白臉白前頸與深色眼線。黑頸鸊鷉較小（28–34 cm）、頭較大冠較陡，頰與頸灰暗。
角鸊鷉繁殖羽有金黃色角狀耳羽及栗色頸胸；本卡黑頸鸊鷉為灰暗冬羽，沒有金色耳羽。角鸊鷉在香港僅有單一偶見紀錄，圖只作異地易混淆種參照。

featureNotes: 冬羽頭頂深色區向下延伸，與暗頰融合、邊界較模糊
近看可見紅虹膜；頭部較大，頸側呈灰暗色
冠頂較陡、喙較窄尖；喙端沒有角鸊鷉的淡色區
頸側及脇通常偏白，與暗冠及上體形成對比

rangeMap.note: Partial broad-range overview. Eurasian nominate taxon breeds from northwestern Europe east to western Mongolia and northeastern China, wintering along coasts in Japan, south China and around the Mediterranean; North American P. n. californicus breeds in Canada/USA and winters in North America, while African P. n. gurneyi is largely resident. Highlighted countries are partial broad-range context only, not nationwide occupancy or exact seasonal/subspecies polygons; Hong Kong is separately identified as a rare winter visitor.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: Category I, rare winter visitor; Hong Kong records occur 19 November–4 March, all in Deep Bay sites. 28–34 cm; compared with Little Grebe, larger head, steeper crown, narrower pointed bill, less dumpy body, red iris; sides of neck and flanks generally white; diffuse dark area extends behind eye. IUCN LC, trend unknown; Eurasian and American subspecies ranges distinguished.

Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: winter birds grayish overall with dark cap blending into dark cheek and smudgy dark neck; red eye visible close up; compared with Horned Grebe, Eared is thinner-necked, smaller-headed, more peaked crown, darker cheek and no pale bill tip.
Full HKBWS Great Crested Grebe account read for comparator: 46–61 cm, long neck and bill; winter face and fore-neck white with dark crown/eye-bill line.
Full HKBWS Horned Grebe account read for comparator: Hong Kong has a single accidental record; breeding plumage with golden ear tufts and rich rufous underparts, unlike winter Black-necked Grebe.
